summary: CAIR Action endorsed Yvonne Inciarte in the general election, and Vote for Peace, which rates candidates on human rights and AIPAC funding, listed her as an Ally. Her District 2 City Council platform addresses only local Santa Clara priorities—renter protection, emergency response, infrastructure upkeep, and small-business policy—without statements on Gaza or Israel. The two pro-Palestine organizational recommendations are the concrete stance evidence for her position.
